title: Assert the eight-reader ceiling for archive validity reads on any host (CH-M11)
description: Assert the eight-reader ceiling for archive validity reads on any host (CH-M11)
acceptance_criteria: REQ-cli-033 gains a criterion: with twelve affected archives no more than 8 validity reads run at once, and the reader count is at most 8 whatever parallelism the host reports. The reader count is a pure function with no behavior change. A unit test holds the ceiling for a host reporting 128 cores, and a 12-cold-archive integration test observes at most 8 overlapping reads. Both fail with the ceiling raised to 128 (the audit's CH-M11 mutant) and pass restored; the existing overlap test still passes. fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Audit CH-M11 (mutation .clamp(2, 8) -> .clamp(2, 128) survived native_validity_reads_run_in_parallel); Leif's 95% plan C5 (2026-11-05, via the orc): a test that asserts the eight-reader ceiling, which the mutation must fail; never weaken a test, gate, bound or timeout. The ceiling stays 8 and the floor 2; no runtime behavior changes.
